The concept

A full page, built around the favourites

This demo turns the drinks visitors order most into a complete visit — menu, gallery, and directions in one place.

The menu above lists items and prices from the shop's DoorDash menu, and every photo on this page is illustrative stock — not photography of this business. What this concept adds is structure: the favourites up front, the visit details in one place, and a clear next step at the bottom.

Kalispell Koffee (Timberline Coffee) now runs two spots in Kalispell — the original at 1011 US Hwy 2 W, plus a second spot at 1192 E Idaho St that opened in October 2026. If anything here looks out of date, the fastest check is a phone call — hours, availability, and the day's specials are best confirmed directly.
